name: Yatoon Appointment Booking for Salons & Spas
author: yatoon

sections.description:
Yatoon Appointment Booking for Salons & Spa is the appointment booking plugin designed from the ground up for salons, spas, nail studios, and beauty businesses. While generic booking plugins treat every business the same, Yatoon speaks your language — service menus, staff profiles, tip collection, photo galleries, and group appointments are all built in, not bolted on.

Your clients book in minutes from any device. You stay organized with a clean dashboard, smart calendar, and every tool you need to reduce no-shows and grow repeat business.

Why salon owners choose Yatoon

Most booking plugins were built for dentists or accountants. Yatoon was built for you. It looks beautiful out of the box, works perfectly on mobile, and handles the things that matter in a beauty business — multiple services per visit, group appointments, service photos, tip collection, and client reviews.

Booking Flow

  • Multi-step booking with animated progress bar — clients always know where they are
  • Group appointments — book services for yourself and a guest at the same time, each with their own services and staff
  • Multi-service booking — add as many services as needed in one appointment
  • Service options & add-ons — offer variations (e.g. short/long, gel/regular) and optional extras
  • Staff selection — clients choose their preferred technician, or pick “Any available”
  • Real-time availability — live calendar with Week and Month views; times load directly from your schedule
  • Waitlist — when a date is fully booked, clients join the waitlist and get notified when a slot opens
  • “Text Us” fallback — if no times are available, clients can reach you directly with one tap

Service Display

  • [yatoon_service_menu] — a restaurant-style service menu with category filter tabs, service descriptions, pricing, and duration. Clients browse and book without leaving the page
  • [yatoon_catalog] — image card grid with category filters and a Book button on each card
  • [yatoon_gallery] — auto-scrolling infinite photo carousel. Upload multiple photos per service; display all or filter by category or service. Supports mobile swipe, desktop drag, dot navigation, and lightbox

Staff Profiles

  • Profile photos, display names, and bios
  • Star ratings pulled automatically from verified client reviews
  • Popular and Experienced badges assigned from real booking data
  • Up to 2 staff members in the free version

Reviews & Ratings

  • After every completed appointment, clients receive an automated email to leave a star rating
  • One-tap rating (1–5 stars) — no login required
  • Optional written review
  • Admin review management — approve, reject, feature, or delete
  • Average rating displayed on staff cards and service cards

Client Experience

  • Booking confirmation with full appointment summary
  • Add to Calendar — Google Calendar and Apple/Outlook (.ics) with one tap
  • Rebooking nudge — configurable reminder shown on the confirmation page to encourage clients to book their next visit
  • Customer portal ([yatoon_customer_portal]) — clients view upcoming and past appointments, reschedule, or cancel without calling
  • Manage booking page ([yatoon_manage_booking]) — secure link in confirmation emails lets clients manage their booking directly
  • Cancellation & no-show policy display at checkout

Custom Booking Form

  • Drag-and-drop custom fields builder — add any question to the booking form
  • 6 field types: text, textarea, dropdown, checkbox, radio, file upload
  • Examples: allergy notes, reference image URL, skin type, first-visit question, nail shape preference

Tip / Gratuity

  • Preset percentage buttons (15%, 18%, 20%) or custom amount
  • Fully configurable from Settings — enable, disable, or change percentages

Admin Dashboard

  • KPI cards — today’s appointments, monthly revenue, no-show rate
  • 7-day trend chart — see booking volume at a glance
  • Today’s timeline — every appointment for today in chronological order
  • Needs Attention panel — pending bookings, no-shows, and waitlist entries that need action
  • Clients page — full client list with visit history, notes, and tags
  • Closed Dates manager — block holidays and training days for all staff at once, with a live preview calendar and quick-add buttons for common holidays

Shortcodes

Booking

  • [yatoon_booking] — full multi-step booking form
  • [yatoon_customer_portal] — client self-service portal
  • [yatoon_manage_booking] — secure reschedule / cancel page

Gallery & Catalog

  • [yatoon_gallery] — auto-scrolling photo carousel (all services)
  • [yatoon_gallery service_id="5"] — photos for one specific service
  • [yatoon_gallery category="Manicures"] — photos filtered by category
  • [yatoon_gallery cols="5" ratio="9/16" mode="slider"] — full options
  • [yatoon_catalog] — service image card grid with Book button
  • [yatoon_catalog category="Enhancements"] — filtered by category

Menu & Reviews

  • [yatoon_service_menu] — full restaurant-style service menu
  • [yatoon_reviews] — display approved star ratings (Pro)

Gallery Shortcode Options

  • cols — columns on desktop (default: 5)
  • limit — max images to show (default: 50)
  • ratio — aspect ratio: 1/1, 4/3, 3/4, 9/16, 16/9 (default: 1/1)
  • mobile_height — fixed height on mobile, e.g. 500px
  • mode — grid (default) or slider
  • service_id — show only this service’s photos
  • category — show only this category’s photos
  • lightbox — 1 or 0 (default: 1)
  • interval — autoplay speed in ms (default: 3500)

Upgrade to Pro

The free version covers everything a solo or small salon needs. Yatoon Pro adds the power features that growing businesses rely on:

  • Square & Vagaro calendar sync — pull real-time availability from your existing calendar. No double bookings, ever
  • SMS appointment reminders via Twilio — automated texts before every appointment cut no-shows by up to 50%
  • Google Calendar sync — two-way sync keeps your personal and business calendars aligned
  • Unlimited staff members — no cap on technicians, therapists, or service providers
  • Deposit & prepay — require upfront payment for high-value services or clients with a no-show history
  • No-show tracking — automatically flag clients who miss appointments and require a deposit on future bookings
  • Waitlist auto-notify — the moment a cancellation opens up, the next person on the waitlist gets an email instantly
  • Service packages — sell pre-paid bundles (e.g. Buy 5 manicures, get 1 free) directly from your site
  • Recurring appointments — clients set up weekly or bi-weekly repeat bookings from the confirmation page
  • [yatoon_reviews] shortcode — display your star ratings anywhere on your site
  • Branding controls — custom accent color, button labels, and logo
  • Priority support — direct access to the Yatoon team

Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, upload the ZIP, and click Activate
  2. Go to Yatoon Booking > Settings and configure your business name, hours, and preferences
  3. Add [yatoon_booking] to your booking page
  4. Add [yatoon_service_menu] to your services page
  5. Add [yatoon_gallery] to your homepage or gallery page
  6. Upload service photos: Services > Edit any service > Gallery Images > + Add Images

External Services

The free version uses no external services. The Freemius SDK is bundled for optional licensing and upgrade management.

  • Freemius: https://freemius.com — Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
sections.faq:
Does this work with Square or Vagaro?

Real-time Square and Vagaro calendar sync is available in Yatoon Pro. The free version supports local availability management through the built-in calendar.

Can clients book for a group?

Yes. Yatoon supports group appointments — your client can book services for themselves and a guest in a single checkout, with separate service and staff selection for each person.

Can I add multiple services to one appointment?

Yes. Clients can add as many services as needed. The booking form shows a running total of time and price, and the calendar finds a start time that fits the full combined duration.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yatoon is designed mobile-first. The booking form, service menu, and photo gallery all work smoothly on phones and tablets.

Does it send confirmation emails?

Yes. Automated confirmation emails go out immediately after booking, with a full appointment summary and a link to manage or reschedule.

Can clients leave a star rating without creating an account?

Yes. After their appointment, clients receive an email with a one-tap star rating link. No login or account required.

How do I display my service photos?

Upload photos to each service (Services > Edit > Gallery Images), then add [yatoon_gallery] to any page. The carousel auto-scrolls and supports swipe on mobile.

What languages is Yatoon available in?

Yatoon is translation-ready and compatible with WPML and Polylang. All strings are localized.

2.6.2

  • Improved: “Make Another Booking” button now clearly separated from action buttons with a divider line

2.6.1

  • Fix: Business phone number now correctly appears in confirmation emails

2.6.0

  • Fix: Booking confirmation no longer hangs — extended server timeout for booking submission
  • Fix: Business phone number now appears correctly in confirmation emails
  • Fix: “Make Another Booking” button now has proper spacing below the action buttons

2.5.4

  • Fix: {business_phone} variable now correctly shows the phone number in confirmation emails

2.5.3

  • Improved: “Make Another Booking” button spacing increased for a cleaner separation from the action buttons above

2.5.2

  • Fix: Booking confirmation no longer hangs indefinitely — PHP execution time limit extended to prevent silent timeouts during booking submission
  • Fix: “Make Another Booking” button now appears on its own line below the action buttons for a cleaner layout

2.5.1

  • Fix: Customer self-service cancel/reschedule (Manage Booking) now works in Square mode — token is generated for all booking platforms
  • Fix: Multi-service bookings now show correct service names in Staff Portal (booking_options populated on Square sync)
  • Fix: Appointment times display correctly across all browsers including Safari (Unix timestamp format)
  • Fix: Staff Portal day tabs now show text in correct color on all backgrounds
  • Fix: ZIP package folder name corrected to yatoon-booking-system for proper WordPress installation

2.5.0

  • New: Staff Portal PWA — technicians can view their weekly schedule and manage appointment status from their phone. Add [yatoon_staff_portal] to any page, set a 4-digit PIN per staff member under Settings > Staff, and share the link. Installable as a home screen app on iOS and Android.
  • New: Set PIN button in Staff admin table — securely hashed, with brute-force rate limiting (10 attempts per 5 minutes per IP)

2.4.0

  • New: Checkout Options — Gift Card and Coupon Code fields can now be individually toggled on/off in Settings > Checkout Options
  • New: Coupon Code now has an Apply button with real-time validation and discount preview at checkout
  • New: Multi-Location support — add unlimited locations under Yatoon Booking > Locations, each with its own address, description, phone, email, timezone, and accent color. Use [yatoon_booking location=”2″] or [yatoon_booking location=”downtown”] to scope a booking form to a specific location
  • Improved: Location banner shown on booking form when a specific location is selected via shortcode
  • Note: Pro users can assign a separate Square Location ID per location for independent live availability sync

2.3.6

  • Fix: Removed “Checking availability…” indicator on service cards — availability is shown at the time selection step instead

2.3.5

  • New: Multi-person booking gets a cleaner, more intuitive interface — each person’s services are clearly grouped and easier to manage
  • Improved: No-availability message now shows the specific service name (single service) or total appointment count (multiple services) for clearer feedback
  • Improved: Service menu category tabs now sit closer to the first section heading for a tighter, more polished layout
  • Removed: “Checking availability…” indicator on service cards — availability is shown at the time selection step instead
  • Fix: Duplicate service modal — “Dismiss” button now closes the popup and keeps the client on the service menu instead of jumping to the time selection step
  • Fix: UP/DOWN reorder buttons now only appear when the same person has 2 or more services

2.2.0

  • New: Apple-style service cards with hero image, rounded corners, soft shadow, and Book pill button
  • New: Star rating and review count on each service card
  • New: “Next Available” hint on service cards with green pulsing dot
  • New: Week/Month calendar in local mode replaces native date picker
  • Improved: Service card typography, padding, and selected-state ring

2.1.2

  • New: International phone number support with country flag picker
  • New: Email OTP and SMS OTP verification before booking confirmation
  • New: Phone number optional toggle

2.1.0

  • New: [yatoon_gallery] infinite-loop auto-scrolling photo carousel
  • New: [yatoon_catalog] service image card grid with popup booking
  • New: Custom booking form fields with drag-and-drop builder
  • New: Tip / gratuity at checkout
  • New: Star rating collection and Reviews admin page
  • New: Recurring appointments
  • New: Closed Dates manager
  • New: Redesigned dashboard with KPI cards and trend chart

2.0.0

  • Initial public release
